label: TotalEnergyFlowState
info:
Reads Total Energy Flow State from registers:
- 72-75: Battery charge/discharge total
- 78-82: Grid buy/sell total
- 85-86: Load total
- 92+95: Generator total
- 96-97: PV total

Triggers:
1. Daily at 23:58

name: Prepare read (Battery 72-75)
Prepare read (Grid 78-82)
Prepare read (Load 85-86)
Prepare read (Gen 92-95)
Prepare read (PV 96-97)
Build TotalEnergyFlowState JSON
